name: Enterprise Fund Committee Meeting Agenda 1-15-2020

CITY OF EL MONTE

  MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  January 15, 2020 – 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West
  Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California
1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Special Meeting Minutes of October 8, 2019

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A) Discussion, Update and Request for Direction Regarding Meter
  Replacement;
  B) Review Sewer Master Plan; and
  C) Update on CIP Jobs.

  7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

  8.  ADJOURN MEETING
